{"id":1837256436,"question_id":4135,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763865818,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1837256436/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Concatenate Non-Zero Digits and Multiply by Sum I","memory":"9.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long sumAndMultiply(int n) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        string s = to_string(n);\n        long long sum = 0;\n        for(auto ch : s){\n            if(ch != '0'){\n                ans.push_back(ch);\n                sum += ch - '0';\n            } \n        }\n        long long new_n = ans.empty() ? 0 : stoll(ans);\n        long long new_sum = new_n * sum;\n        return new_sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"concatenate-non-zero-digits-and-multiply-by-sum-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1167}
